title: Project P.I.T.T. Cauldron — 1.0.8 Anomaly Recipe Tiers & Use
description: Cauldron tiers after Update 1.0.8: which combos make lower/normal/enhanced Anomalies, plus troubleshooting for the Cauldron not working and ejected inputs.
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Cauldron — 1.0.8 Anomaly Recipe Tiers & Use
quickAnswer: After Update 1.0.8: 3 identical products → lower-quality Anomaly; 3 products using only 2 distinct product types (2 different/3 total) → normal-quality Anomaly; one Duck + one Cash Register + one Piñata → enhanced-quality Anomaly. Run one complete manual Cauldron cycle and confirm a successful craft before automating.

facts.label: Cauldron (Anomaly workbench) — Updated 1.0.8
facts.value: The Cauldron is the Anomaly workbench (official 1.0.8 naming). Update 1.0.8 formalizes crafting from three inputs and adds explicit three-tier quality outcomes.

facts.label: Recipe tiers (1.0.8 rules)
facts.value: After 1.0.8 there are three quality tiers: 3 of the same product → lower-quality Anomaly; 3 products composed of only 2 distinct product types → normal-quality Anomaly; one-of-each (see enhanced example) → enhanced-quality Anomaly.

facts.label: Enhanced combo example
facts.value: The mapped enhanced-quality example from 1.0.8 is one Duck + one Cash Register + one Piñata. This specific one-of-each set yields enhanced quality; it is an example, not a claim that it is the only possible enhanced set.

facts.label: Troubleshooting & ejection (manual first)
facts.value: Always complete one successful manual Cauldron cycle before automating. Inputs must physically enter the Cauldron—items sitting nearby may not register. Piñata items remain fragile in transit and can break. Automation amplifies staging or timing failures. Community reports (not official patch rules) note per-ingredient stock limits can cause items to eject or pop out.
